note: Hook-based tweaks for core's link field / link_default widget. Config UI route link_field_tweak.settings (/admin/config/content/link-field-tweak). Three storage locations: site-wide config object link_field_tweak.settings (widget_field_order, add_another_link, uri_part_required); per-widget third_party_settings.link_field_tweak.* on entity_form_display components (link_default_field_order, uri_part_custom_help(+_text), title_part_custom_help(+_text), uri_part_required, autocomplete_route_name_change); and two field formatters link_text / link_text_empty (setting link_text) on entity_view_display. Medium cases read a seeded per-widget custom help text and a seeded site-wide toggle; hard cases turn a per-widget field-order third-party setting on, and enable the site-wide add_another_link toggle, verified against live config/displays.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site I want the core Link field's widget to show the Title box above the URL box (like Drupal 7). What module does that and where is the site-wide setting?
evals.expected_output: Link Field tweaks provides it. Enable the site-wide toggle at Configuration > Content authoring > Link field settings (/admin/config/content/link-field-tweak), which sets link_field_tweak.settings.widget_field_order; you can also set it per widget (link_default_field_order third-party setting).

evals.prompt: Using link_field_tweak, how can I make a link field always render with a fixed anchor text like 'Read more' regardless of the stored link title? Which formatter and setting?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'Link text' formatter (id link_text) on Manage display and set its link_text setting (e.g. 'Read more'); it overrides the field's link text (XSS-filtered). 'Link text replacing empty text' (link_text_empty) applies the fixed text only when the title is empty.

evals.prompt: I need to replace the default help text under a Link field's URL box with my own instructions, and add help under the Title box (which core has none). How does link_field_tweak let me do that and where is it stored?
evals.expected_output: On the field's Manage form display, open the link widget settings and enable 'custom help text' for the URI (uri_part_custom_help + uri_part_custom_help_text) and/or Title (title_part_custom_help + title_part_custom_help_text). These persist as third_party_settings.link_field_tweak.* on the entity_form_display component.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a link field named field_lft_known whose widget uses link_field_tweak to show custom URL help text. Inspect the live default form display and report the exact custom help text configured for its URL part.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_lft_known component has third_party_settings.link_field_tweak.uri_part_custom_help = true and uri_part_custom_help_text = 'Known campaign URL help'.

evals.prompt: This site has link_field_tweak installed. Inspect its live site-wide settings and state which of the three global toggles (switch field order, relabel 'Add another item', require URL when title filled) is currently enabled, naming the config key.
evals.expected_output: In link_field_tweak.settings, add_another_link is TRUE (relabel 'Add another item' to 'Add another link'), while widget_field_order and uri_part_required are FALSE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a link field field_lft_task using the core link widget. Using link_field_tweak, configure that widget (per-widget, on the default form display) to switch the field order so the Title appears before the URL, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_lft_task component carries third_party_settings.link_field_tweak.link_default_field_order = true (tick 'Switch field order' on the widget in Manage form display, or set it on the component and save).

evals.prompt: Using link_field_tweak on this site, turn on the site-wide option that relabels the link widget's 'Add another item' button to 'Add another link', and save it to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: The config object link_field_tweak.settings has add_another_link = true (set via the Link field settings form at /admin/config/content/link-field-tweak or drush cset), saved to the live site.
